name: PdxRichText
description: A rich text editor with no dependencies, with Markdown shortcuts, syntax highlighting and tables.

members.name: output
members.description: Output format: 'html' or 'json'.

members.name: extensions
members.description: Editor extensions to enable.

members.name: preset
members.description: A named toolbar/feature preset.

members.name: toolbar
members.description: A preset ('full', 'standard', 'compact', 'minimal'), button names with '|' between groups, or 'false' for none.

members.name: toolbarMode
members.description: Toolbar layout: 'top' (a bar above the text) or 'bubble' (floating over the selection).

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Placeholder text shown while empty.

members.name: readonly
members.description: Makes the value read-only — visible but not editable.

members.name: autofocus
members.description: Focuses the editor on mount.

members.name: height
members.description: Fixed editor height.

members.name: minHeight
members.description: Minimum editor height.

members.name: maxHeight
members.description: Maximum editor height before scrolling.

members.name: source
members.description:
A DataSource whose record `record-id` names: the editor edits that record's `field`, follows
it when the source changes it, and writes each edit back through the source.
With all three given, the record is the document and `value` only reflects it.

members.name: field
members.description: The field of the `source` record that holds the document.

members.name: recordId
members.description: The id of the `source` record to edit, as pdx-form's `record-id`: `"1"` finds `{ id: 1 }`.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name of the editing area. Empty → the `rich-text.label` component string.

members.name: value
members.description: The current value.

members.name: editor
members.description: Read-only, via a ref: `el.editor`.

members.name: getJSON
members.description: The document as JSON, or null while the editor is still being built.

members.name: getHTML
members.description: The document as HTML — what a copy to the clipboard carries — or '' before the editor is built.

members.name: getText
members.description: The document as plain text, or '' before the editor is built.

members.name: getWordCount
members.description: How many words the document holds; 0 before the editor is built.

members.name: isEmpty
members.description: Read-only, via a ref: `el.isEmpty`.

members.name: execCommand
members.description: Run one editor command by name, the same ones the toolbar runs. Does nothing before the editor is built.

members.name: focus
members.description: Moves focus to it.

members.name: blur
members.description: Removes focus from it.

members.name: setJSON
members.description: Replace the document with this JSON, waiting for the editor when it is not built yet.

members.name: setHTML
members.description: Replace the document with this HTML, waiting for the editor when it is not built yet.

members.name: clear
members.description: Clears the value.

events.name: pdx-ready
events.description: The editor is built; the imperative API has been there since setup.

events.name: value-change
events.description: Fired when the component writes `value`. Does not bubble.

attributes.name: toolbarmode
attributes.description: Toolbar layout: 'top' (a bar above the text) or 'bubble' (floating over the selection).

attributes.name: readonly

slots.description: The content placed inside the element.

cssParts.name: field
cssParts.description: The frame around the text: its height and scrolling.

cssStates.name: readonly
cssStates.description: `readonly` is set; the text is not editable and the textbox is aria-readonly.
